purpose: Test whether official Spatial task1 is learnable alone under the current verified pipeline before attributing the mixed-batch8 task1 deficit to task interactions or considering any task-count expansion.

evidence_basis.task0_current_single_control: results/teacher_native_spatial_4task_mixbatch8_freshseed2001_40k_training_result_v1_20261014.json and the registered attempt-2 CPU audit: seed2001 task0 single 40k baseline met 16/20 paired and 5/5 fixed init3.
evidence_basis.task1_mixed_batch8: results/teacher_native_spatial_4task_mixbatch8_freshseed2001_eval_attempt2_cpu_audit_v1_20261014.json: task1 8/20 paired and 0/5 fixed init3; four-task progression gate failed.
evidence_basis.matched_starts: results/teacher_native_spatial_4task_mixbatch8_freshseed2001_eval_attempt2_cpu_audit_v1_20261014.json: 20/20 paired task1 starts match across recorded simulator, image, processor, and RNG inputs between the homogeneous joint4 and mixed-batch8 evaluations.
evidence_basis.failure_phenotype: results/teacher_native_spatial_task1_horizon_diagnostic_v1_20261014.json: the five old-success/new-failure pairs in the mixed-batch8 contrast all reached the 300-step cap. This is descriptive and does not identify cause.

options_compared.option: Advance to 8 tasks or unlock Fold02
options_compared.reason: The unchanged four-task gate failed at task1; the stage gate forbids progression.

options_compared.option: Repeat or extend mixed-batch8 training immediately
options_compared.reason: The cap phenotype does not distinguish task difficulty from training-treatment effects; extending the same condition would not establish task1 single-task learnability.

options_compared.option: One seed2001 task1-only run matched to 40k task0 recipe and task1 per-task exposure, then 24 evaluations
options_compared.reason: It directly tests task1 single-task learnability while holding initialization, pretrained base, optimizer recipe, update count, task1 samples per update, and LR schedule exposure to the available matched comparisons; one bounded run is more discriminating than another mixed-task run.

options_compared.option: Stop additional GPU work and retain the current diagnostic conclusion
options_compared.reason: No new GPU budget is assumed by this registration.

falsifiable_hypothesis.claim: The task1 data and current single-task training pipeline can achieve the already registered per-task learnable-signal threshold when trained alone at matched task1 sample and LR exposure.
falsifiable_hypothesis.positive_signal: At least 10/20 paired task1 successes and 5/5 fixed-init3 successes under the frozen evaluator.
falsifiable_hypothesis.interpretation: Passing would establish a task1 single-task positive-control signal and make a task-mixture effect plausible for seed2001; it would not prove causality or pass the four-task gate. Failing would point toward task1 difficulty, data/recipe, or single-task optimization issues and would not justify task-count expansion.

proposed_training.pretrained_base: /root/smolvla-training-prep/models/smolvla_base_libero; no warm-start from a trained checkpoint
proposed_training.lr_schedule: Copy the exact task0 seed2001 40k config and verify the effective 40k LR vector and trainer scaling in read-only preflight.
preflight_required_before_any_launch: Revalidate source HDF5-to-LeRobot conversion manifest, task1 episode slice 50..99, metadata/statistics, frame/image parity, and filtered loader.
Verify exact base-model, trainer, scheduler, config-byte, and effective LR-vector hashes against the seed2001 task0 40k run.
Verify requested output/log/PID/exit paths are absent and distinct; preserve all old task1 failed-run paths.
Verify GPU lock/process exclusivity, free GPU memory, and at least 20 GiB free disk before launch.
If every check passes, require a separate explicit go-ahead before launch; this record alone is not launch authority.

evaluation.protocol: benchmark initialization source, wait 10, max_steps 300, n_action_steps 25
evaluation.fixed_init3: 5 total observations including paired init3 plus four additional repeats; CLI seed 12348 for each additional repeat (effective seed 12351)

hard_bounds.budget: This registration proposes one bounded run plus its 24-rollout evaluation; no additional run or spend is authorized by this file.
hard_bounds.current_state: Not launched; GPU budget for this proposal remains zero until the user explicitly authorizes it.

stop_conditions: Any preflight mismatch, existing target path, data/config/model hash mismatch, active conflicting process, failed lock acquisition, insufficient disk, or launch error: preserve evidence and stop without retry or path substitution.
Training error or missing/incomplete final checkpoint: preserve the failed run and stop; do not evaluate or restart.
Any evaluator/protocol/data-parity mismatch or evaluation error: preserve partial output and stop without retry.
Do not unlock Fold02 or advance task count based on this diagnostic alone.
publication_policy: Only this lightweight registration/README may be synced. Never upload checkpoints, raw HDF5/Parquet, action arrays, trajectories, videos, training logs, secrets, or credentials.
